instruction: Look at guih10_hydraulic_manifold_seed.dxf in LibreCAD. For the steps below, launch LibreCAD from `/usr/bin/librecad` before opening `guih10_hydraulic_manifold_seed.dxf`. Complete the hard hydraulic manifold drilling diagram. Draw OUTLINE rectangle (0,0)-(220,120). Add PORT circles radius 9 at (35,100), (85,100), (135,100), and (185,100), labels P, T, A, and B above them, lower PORT circles radius 6 at (35,20) and (185,20), PASSAGE lines (35,100)-(35,20), (85,100)-(185,20), (135,100)-(35,20), (185,100)-(185,20), and (0,60)-(220,60), central CUT circle center (110,60) radius 14, and notes MANIFOLD M-42, CROSS DRILL 6 PLACES, PLUG BOTH ENDS, and PORTS P T A B. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih10_hydraulic_manifold_completed.dxf.
